correctness.rationale: Full proof reconstructs the transfer-current covariance identity from the weighted matrix-tree polynomial; the exact split-graph Laplacian pseudoinverse leads to explicit covariance blocks, an orthogonal decomposition accounting for all edge dimensions, and strict rational inequalities proving the q=3 transition for every p>=3. The p=2 exception is handled separately. Exact rational enumeration across nine graphs (20,219 trees, 1,565 covariance entries), plus 64 trace/squared-trace profiles, corroborates the algebra without pretending finite tests certify all cases. No critical step requires a numerical conjecture.

The inaccessible 2023 full paper is a residual priority risk, not evidence of not-covering.

originality.rationale: Specific full-text source comparisons and published-claim searches identify no theorem of complete-split vertex-uniform tree covariance spectra and universal q=3 extremal-mode switch. Classical transfer-current and complete-multipartite fixed-forest formulas do imply pair moments, which are not claimed as original. The new claim is simultaneous spectral classification, all multiplicities, and exact condition-number phase. Historical priority remains provisional; one plausible 2023 source was inaccessible in full text.
residual_risks: The full text of Li–Chen–Yan (2023) was not obtained; it may contain an equivalent specialized covariance statement or unstated consequence.
Earlier graph-spanning-tree statistics literature using alternative terminology may contain an equivalent eigenspectrum; search absence cannot establish priority.
Independent novelty confirmation has not been performed.

value.rationale: A complete infinite two-parameter graphic-matroid base-polytope covariance spectrum provides intrinsic quantitative geometry rather than a single edge-count identity. The clique-size-independent switch at exactly three independent-set vertices, and explicit multiplicity/conditioning formulas, identify a natural sharp phase boundary. The nontrivial part is block diagonalization and exact extremal comparison, not the classical transfer-current formula. The claim is structurally motivated and does not rely on speculative applications.
